title: Nasdaq EVP & CFO Sarah Youngwood to Present at Barclays 24th Annual Global Financial Services Conference
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Nasdaq, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.

[PDF Version](https://ir.nasdaq.com/node/110976/pdf)


NEW YORK, Sept. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Nasdaq (Nasdaq: NDAQ) will be presenting at the following conference with a webcast link available at Nasdaq’s Investor Relations website:[https://ir.nasdaq.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=JEhSyCsTPUU6yl-bDlNLYkDmgeIkWoY43Kqkb0UOhpk1k9GmhroQcLP49m9j2fWp0nObGoNUyAnf4yN8FXIro4jrAk8F19VN6rSk4DBCWjE=) .


**Who:** Sarah Youngwood, Executive Vice President & Chief Financial Officer, Nasdaq


**What:** Barclays 24th Annual Global Financial Services Conference


**When:** Monday, September 14th, 12:00 PM ET


**About Nasdaq**
Nasdaq (Nasdaq: NDAQ) is a leading technology platform that powers the world’s economies. We architect the infrastructure of the world’s most modern markets, power the innovation economy, and build trust in the financial system. We empower economic opportunity by designing and deploying advanced technology, data, and intelligence solutions that enable our clients to capture opportunities, navigate risk, and strengthen resilience. To learn more about the company, technology solutions and career opportunities, visit us on[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=FNLQXPMcktaFxCF2LaYxrYmZDZpHJsup4FP6v_NIJVInn-gNl3bIW7waAWEzPHe9_QI9B7KO7uwzjDzIld-ZxBh5FroBuU00lUB7NP-YvyJBwl_LxVS2mv6xy0Psd5kX) , on X[@Nasdaq](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=00USEaz_IOXXkA61V_BORa7aEnAAG5M5dgkb5wFZvHrrApT93Qlw8c-lMvAV-Qg66c5ZHQU4-Oyoq7wo5OGDsQ==) , or at[www.nasdaq.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=KjBHa-xtCM8fxCW5jab3FybOoG1i1zs_syIfDbuNPgTEwO5vIl9ojoScylBP4ExTOGO4v8_fLjYkQi6_Mj7t6g==) .
